notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hello 
I want to thanks everyone that is still playing this game for such a long time, as you can see I still want to develop this project and make it better and better. I release a big update today and I hope you all will like it.

:)

notes.title: New BIG update !
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː
It's been a long time since the last update.  Since the launch game has changed in a great way.  I hope that this version will appeal to you.

New heroes

An extended plot

Corrected errors

The new flying system

A new object to build

A new mystery

notes.title: GREAT UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi This is new version of Amelon 
Many things have changed for better !

 - You can buy different cars ! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31378653/1951496b6cad1001d7044750cc6e0f3ff323a328.jpg[/img]

- You can build machines in wherever place you like using just RMB 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31378653/f4a80767805aee77c4efafc1b72888569d8e9717.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31378653/75760d5129bbf4e5e22d035921de79b13ad62d66.jpg[/img]

- There is no more errors or bugs in The Hospital, everything is just perfect there
